candidates.reason: Preaggregates pickups by location before the LEFT JOIN. Summing joined counts preserves duplicate zone matches and the NULL borough group; the cast preserves COUNT(*)'s BIGINT type.
candidates.sql:
WITH pickups AS (
  SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY PULocationID
)
SELECT z.Borough AS borough, CAST(SUM(p.n) AS BIGINT) AS trips
FROM pickups p
LEFT JOIN zones z ON p.PULocationID = z.LocationID
GROUP BY z.Borough

candidates.reason: Replaces the rolling window with a join on observed-day row positions. AVG retains its DOUBLE type, while ranking preserves anomalous dates and the NULL-day group without filling calendar gaps.
candidates.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS trips
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY 1
), ranked AS (
  SELECT day, trips, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY day ASC NULLS LAST) AS rn
  FROM daily
)
SELECT current_day.day AS day, AVG(prior_day.trips) AS rolling
FROM ranked current_day
JOIN ranked prior_day
  ON prior_day.rn BETWEEN current_day.rn - 2 AND current_day.rn
GROUP BY current_day.rn, current_day.day
ORDER BY current_day.day ASC NULLS LAST
